verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as broadcasting input or applying an action across many windows or sessions at once, are a fair axis for a terminal emulator. The evidence only shows single-target features: creating one window via `alacritty msg create-window`, multi-window support within one process, and text selection modes. None of these acts on many items at once, so there is no documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
